The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (November 4, 2021) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Quotation, Ariba Document Number 3099929980 Description: For the Supply and Delivery of Five (5) Latest Model Conventional Cab And Truck Chassis Low Profile With Dual Rear Wheels Complete With An 18' Van Body, 26,000 LBS (11,793 KG) GVWR, with option to purchase an additional One (1) unit in 2022, Five (5) units in 2023, Three (3) units in 2024 and One (1) unit in 2025, pending budget availability. Upon Award of this RFQ, the Vendor and the City will have a Contract from date of award for a period of five (5) years, all in accordance with the terms, conditions, and specifications contained in this RFQ and any applicable City policy.…
